headlines.text: Turning the clock back to 2023: there was a changing of the guard for the NJPW STRONG Openweight Title as Eddie Kingston vs. Claudio Castagnoli battled it out, appearing on Dynamite, rated 8.18 ? a fantastic contest ? ending the champion's reign at 2 defenses. In a title-for-title match built on years of history dating back to their indie days, Kingston finally beat Castagnoli with a spinning back fist and powerbomb to become ROH World Champion.

It was 2025 when Brodido vs. JetSpeed vs. Alexander & Hechicero vs. The Young Bucks clashed for the AEW World Tag Team Titles in a Ladder match, appearing on All Out, rated 8.28 ? one of the better matches of the year. It was the first title opportunity of Alexander & Hechicero's career. Brodido survived a four-way ladder war against the Young Bucks, JetSpeed and the Don Callis Family to retain the AEW World Tag Team Titles.
Rewind to 2024, when Rocky Romero made their return to AEW television after 6 weeks away, appearing on Rampage.

secondaries.text: Back on this day in 2025, Kazuchika Okada vs. Konosuke Takeshita vs. Mascara Dorada clashed for the AEW Unified Title, appearing on All Out, rated 9.10 ? a match fans still talk about. Okada dropkicked Takeshita out of the ring before hitting a Rainmaker on Dorada to retain the Unified Championship, as tension within the Don Callis Family boiled over.

Back on this day in 2025, the AEW Women's World Title found a new home as Kris Statlander vs. Toni Storm vs. Jamie Hayter vs. Thekla battled it out, appearing on All Out, rated 6.83 ? ending the champion's reign at 6 defenses. For Thekla, it marked a first real shot at championship gold. Statlander hooked Storm's limbs for a seatbelt pin to dethrone her in a four-way, becoming a new AEW Women's World Champion.

It was 2025 when Adam Page vs. Kyle Fletcher put the AEW World Heavyweight Title on the line, appearing on All Out, rated 9.27 ? a match that lived up to every bit of hype. Page survived Fletcher borrowing Ospreay's Hidden Blade in a 38-minute classic to retain the AEW World Championship.
